name: Parameterized christmas ball ornament /w led candle holder

captions.detailed: This 3D model features a smooth, spherical Christmas ornament designed with a hollow interior. At the very top (the north pole), there is a small, solid circular hanging loop with a hole through its center for threading a string. The bottom of the sphere includes a flat-rimmed opening, designed to act as a mounting collar for an LED tea light candle.
captions.instruction: Create a parametric, hollow Christmas ornament sphere with a customizable diameter and wall thickness. It should feature an optional hanging loop at the top, a bottom collar designed to mount a standard LED tea light candle, and the ability to pattern decorative cutouts (such as stars, hearts, or pentagrams) around its equator.
captions.factory: The design is constructed using a boolean difference of two concentric sphere primitives to create the hollow shell. A loop module is created by differencing two thin cylinder primitives rotated 90 degrees and translated to the top of the sphere. The bottom LED candle mount is modeled as a hollow cylinder collar, and decorative holes are subtracted using helper modules like polyhedron for custom shapes (triangles, stars) positioned using rotate and translate transforms.
